verdict.rationale: First-party docs show REST endpoints to create contacts (POST /contacts/create) and update them by email or userId (PUT /contacts/update), backed by a published OpenAPI spec, official SDKs, and unlimited contact storage. The suppress/unsubscribe part of the story and explicit custom-property support are not documented in the pack; properties appear only indirectly through dynamic segments. Missing for 10: a documented suppression/unsubscribe API, explicit custom contact property fields in the API, production-scale evidence (rate limits, batch/bulk operations), independent hands-on corroboration.
